    <meta>
        <spec_id>SPEC-0001_DOCKING_PROTOCOL_CONTRACTS</spec_id>
        <protocol_version>1.2</protocol_version>
        <version>1.1.0</version>
        <date>2026-06-27</date>
        <author>Claude</author>
        <status>accepted</status>
    </meta>
    <mission>
        Establish the Docking Protocol as the non-negotiable Central Nervous System (CNS) for all future Claude to implementation-engine communication.
    </mission>
    <scope>
        Create the complete docking directory structure, strict contracts, pre-implementation validation, audit logging, and read-only health surfaces.
    </scope>
    <non_goals>
        Do not implement full lifecycle state machine, dependency graph, ImplementationReport writer, cognitive modules, action modules, or evolution modules.
    </non_goals>
    <target>
        <modules><module>docking</module><module>core/contracts</module></modules>
        <allowed_files>
            docking/**
            core/contracts/docking/**
            core/contracts/spec_protocol.py
            tests/test_docking_protocol.py
            main.py
            core/paths.py
        </allowed_files>
        <forbidden_files>
            src/self_editor.py
            data/**
            models/**
            Setup/**
        </forbidden_files>
    </target>
    <relationships><dependencies></dependencies><supersedes></supersedes></relationships>
    <definition>
        <contracts>
            <contract ref="core/contracts/spec_protocol.py" />
            <contract ref="core/contracts/docking/SpecDocument.py" />
            <contract ref="core/contracts/docking/ChangeTrace.py" />
        </contracts>
        <implementation_requirements>
            Create docking/ with specs/, reports/, contracts/, registry/, protocol/, and audit/ subdirectories.
            Implement strict Pydantic v2 BaseModel contracts with extra fields forbidden.
            Implement validate_spec_before_implementation() with structured JSONL audit logging.
            Expose docking_protocol_status() and get_recent_validation_audit(limit=10).
            Update boot status to report Docking CNS health.
        </implementation_requirements>
        <acceptance_criteria>
            <criterion id="AC-01" type="folder_structure" target="docking/">
                <description>Required docking directories exist.</description>
                <verification>Assert docking/specs, docking/reports, docking/contracts, docking/registry, docking/protocol, and docking/audit exist.</verification>
            </criterion>
            <criterion id="AC-02" type="contract_validation" target="core/contracts/docking/">
                <description>Strict Pydantic SpecDocument and ChangeTrace contracts are importable and reject invalid data.</description>
                <verification>Import both contracts and confirm malformed inputs raise pydantic.ValidationError.</verification>
            </criterion>
            <criterion id="AC-03" type="test" target="docking/protocol/validator.py">
                <description>Pre-implementation validation accepts valid specs, rejects malformed specs, and writes JSONL audit events.</description>
                <verification>Call pre_implementation_validation twice and inspect docking/audit/validation_audit.jsonl.</verification>
            </criterion>
            <criterion id="AC-04" type="integration" target="main.py">
                <description>Boot checks report Docking CNS health without errors.</description>
                <verification>Execute main.py and confirm docking CNS boot status is present.</verification>
            </criterion>
            <criterion id="AC-05" type="audit" target="docking/audit/">
                <description>Recent validation audit events are queryable from docking/specification_protocol.py.</description>
                <verification>Call get_recent_validation_audit(5) and confirm structured timestamp/spec_id/status entries are returned.</verification>
            </criterion>
        </acceptance_criteria>
        <rollback_expectations>
            If rejected or superseded, keep docking infrastructure and audit logs intact.
        </rollback_expectations>
    </definition>
    <impact>
        <deploy>Docking CNS health and audit status become visible at boot.</deploy>
        <risks>Medium if future specs bypass validation; mitigated through audit logging and deploy checks.</risks>
    </impact>
</SpecDocument>
